title: Chapter 6942: A Lesson On Who Can’T Be Bullied

Chapter 6942: A Lesson On Who Can’T Be Bullied

Chapter 6942: A Lesson On Who Can’t Be Bullied

“Sir, it was not my intention to offend you. My junior brother was blind and must have been ignorant of your relationship. Nevertheless, the ladies are perfectly fine, merely sealed in time.” Treasure conceded.

The crowd was surprised due to his famous brutality. Normally, these tyrants always wanted to fight to the very end. However, Treasure had no issue with accepting defeat.

“Go get the ladies!” Treasure yelled at his disciples.

A short moment later, the disciples carried a time sphere to the hall. Within were two women; one was as cold as ice, while the other had an irresistible charm.

Both were powerful, just not when compared to immortals. However, they were from the nine worlds.

“Pop!” Treasure personally removed the seal and bowed: “Ladies, I apologize for my junior brother’s mistake. Please forgive us.”

Once unsealed, they grasped their weapons and looked around, only to see immortals. This didn’t look optimistic.

However, this all changed when they noticed someone else among the crowd.

“Young Noble!” They rushed over and kneeled at the familiar face.

“It’s good that you’re both alright.” Li Qiye smiled and nodded.

They walked behind him and heaved a sigh of relief. Their eyes became slightly moist after finally feeling safe again.

“It must have been difficult, fairies.” Timeflow bowed at them.

They nodded in response, not recognizing him. Meanwhile, the crowd watched attentively.

If these two women were from the nine worlds, was the mortal from the nine worlds as well?

“Sir, all is right again. Please forgive us.” Treasure bowed and apologized.

“There’s nothing to forgive.” Li Qiye smiled.

“How benevolent of you.” Treasure felt much better.

“Don’t be so quick, I didn’t say I would spare you.” Li Qiye said.

“You!” Treasure became startled.

“I can’t go back empty-handed. You can’t think this is the end, right?” Li Qiye said.

“Sir, I was careless, my junior brother was the one who...” Treasure took a deep breath.

“Perpetual Immortal, right? I lit him up, he should burn for tens of millions of years.” Li Qiye said.

Everyone shuddered upon hearing this.

“What do you want?” Treasure’s expression changed continuously.

“I’m thinking about a relatively rough death for you.” Li Qiye stroked his chin.

“Sir, it’s best to keep the peace...” One immortal stepped forward and said.

However, Li Qiye’s glare forced him back immediately as he recalled Treasure’s junior brother’s fate.

No guests stepped forward to speak on Treasure’s behalf, not even the primordial one.

“Sir, don’t push us too far.” Treasure said with a solemn tone.

“Destroy, not push.” Li Qiye smiled.

By now, the crowd wondered if the mortal could actually do it, no longer considering this ludicrous. Breaker branch had a primordial immortal as its leader.

If all three branches in Ancient were to combine, it could almost compete with Guardian or Heaven Assault. Thus, the other two branches’ interference was always part of the equation when it came to destroying Breaker.

“Are you sure?” Treasure uttered coldly.

“A lineage with one primordial immortal? Don’t need to think twice.” Li Qiye smiled.

“You...” Treasure trembled with rage.

The others wondered whether it was easy to destroy Breaker? Only three beings or so could actually do it in Heavenrealm.

However, Breaker Immortal was smart enough never to antagonize these celestial beings. In fact, he often courted their favor.

So was this mortal on the same level as the celestial immortals? Everyone became curious about this unknown being and his true potential.
